notes: Prism 2.6.4: if you started a new call before Prism finished writing up the last one, the app could drop out of recording mode while it was still recording — and then refuse to stop. That's fixed; no recording or audio was ever lost. Prism also now records how it tells two back-to-back meetings apart, so a merged pair can be diagnosed. Also recent: calls that recorded but came back empty now write a real note, notes you renamed keep their names, labels are no longer clickable like text, and the app no longer freezes when a call ends. Your audio is never stored. Free.
